name: SA Cleanser
benefits: Helps loosen dead skin and oil in pores while supporting the skin barrier.
usage: Massage onto damp skin once daily in the evening, then rinse. Follow with moisturiser.
precautions: Can be drying. Avoid combining with other strong exfoliants in the same routine. Patch test first.
